title: docs(pm-dispatch): area-lease asks its L1 thread by thread message, mailboxes only across accounts or projects
body:
Fixes #34487
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`area-lease.md` 的 L1 线程定义处新增一行:向 L1 线程请审或 delta 一律发线程消息,信箱只留跨账号或跨项目;同文件并掉一条复述行付账,行数不变(71/71)。
- 为什么改:维护者裁定同项目内用线程沟通(「但是用信箱沟通没有的 theads 快和省心」),该规则只写进了 `lanes/l2-review.md`,而 `area-lease.md` 写明那份席规不及 L1 线程,照字面读的席位会去敲信箱。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文本一行,无代码、无发布面;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` 第 14 行(新行)与被并入的原「L1 审核只取…」行。
- 两分钟验证:运行 `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期 area-lease.md 为 71 行(上限 71)且退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无:`.claude/**` 属 Tier S,席位凭 L2 契约审核记录落地。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`, one line moved, net 0 lines:

- **Added** at the L1 thread definition (new line 14, right under the `L1-a` / `L1-b` line): `- 请 L1 审或 delta 发线程消息,只取区在 PR 评论宣布的定稿绿 head;信箱只留跨账号或跨项目。` (120 bytes, at the cap.) A review or delta request to an L1 thread goes by thread message; mailboxes stay for traffic across accounts or projects.
- **Removed** from 区内规则: `- L1 审核只取区在 PR 评论宣布定稿的绿 head;修后只 delta。` Its unique half (L1 takes only the green head the area announced final in a PR comment) moves into the new line; its other halves restate SKILL.md 审核两级 (`在定稿绿 head 读 ACCEPT,修后读 delta`).

`SKILL.md` is untouched. Its line 51 (`L2 规则不及 L1`) no longer sends an L1 reader away from the rule, because the rule now lives in the file that defines the L1 threads, not only in `lanes/l2-review.md`. The four files PR #34485 edits are untouched.

## Why

PR #34485 put the maintainer's in-project rule (「但是用信箱沟通没有的 theads 快和省心」, recorded on #34474) into `lanes/l2-review.md`. `area-lease.md` line 13 says that file's seat rules do not reach an L1 thread, so a seat reading the text to the letter knocked a mailbox for its L1 review. This carries should-fix S2 of contract record 6931499577.

## Tests

Skills text only: no package, no test file, nothing published. No unit test or ablation applies.

## Acceptance notes

- The new line has no subject on purpose: it binds whoever asks an L1 thread (an area, or the seat), and keeps the old line's "only the announced green head" rule.
- Built on `origin/main` at `495a79c7b3` (holds PR #34482). PR #34485 was still open when this branch was cut; the two diffs share no file.
